profile.headline: Software Engineer - Starlink
profile.summary:
Hi, my name is Anthony.

I’m passionate about electronics from designing printed circuit boards to developing graphical user interfaces with web technologies. As a computer engineer, I am familiar with C, C#, Java, Python, Verilog, Embedded Systems, and Debugging and rapid prototyping of custom PCBs with Altium/Eagle, 3D Printers, CNC Mills. I have been on multiple robotics team in high school (First Robotics Competition, VEX Robotics, and MATE ROV Competition) and was on the electrical team for Formula SAE Collegiate Competition. Working in a team, we have developed electronic fusing, data acquisition tools, and a variety of embedded systems in an automotive environment.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Full stack on tooling for analysis and operation.

positions.title: Software Engineer 2
positions.description: Working on Starlink Constellation Design through software simulation and analysis.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description: Working on large scale microservices that powers new features in search.

positions.title: Engineer
positions.description: RoseGPE is a student design group that participates in the Formula SAE competition to design, build, and race a Formula 1 style racecar. I work on the electrical aspects of the car which includes design of printed circuit boards, integrating modules with CAN bus, developing firmware for data acquisition and visualization. One of the biggest accomplishment of this year is the use of electronic fusing to improve reliability and diagnostics as well as an ethernet connected dash module that displays information of the car as well as reports telemetry.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: Worked on backend services for O365 Core, improved reliability and developed internal tools to assist in development. Developed in C# and Typescript

positions.title: Avionics Intern
positions.description: Developed internal test tools and wrote test firmware for flight circuit boards.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: Develop features to increase effectiveness of Exchange Search.

positions.title: Robotics Assistant
positions.description: Worked with High School Robotics teams (FRC) to teach basic mechanical and electrical concepts such as frame design using CAD and control system design/programming.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: Develop applications for Windows 10 using a variety of technologies such as Microsoft Azure and Windows 10 IoT.

positions.title: Developer
positions.description: 72 Hours to brainstorm, design, and create a functional prototype of a product with a business model.

positions.title: Intern
positions.description: Interned at the Industrial Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, and Quality Assurance departments for around 4 weeks.
